LanguageData.NMC_SeydasControlNative.label: Mind control
LanguageData.NMC_SeydasControlNative.description:
Make an enemy within 20 cells join the Nivarian survivors. Prefers high-value targets; mechanoids and leaders may be controlled. Costs 50 focus, cooldown 8 seconds.
Allegiance persists after the legion leaves. Controlled units remain Nivarian survivors, not your colonists.
LanguageData.NMC_TebrusStormNative.label: Tebrus psionic storm
LanguageData.NMC_TebrusStormNative.description:
Create a radius-6 psionic storm within 30 cells, only where at least three enemies gather. Costs 35 focus, cooldown 12 seconds.
Lasts 4 seconds. Each second, enemies take 30 base burn damage and allies heal up to 30 injury points or drone durability. Affects downed and invisible units, not buildings.
Cannot remove permanent scars, regrow limbs or cure disease.
